content:
Hi all! Thank you for your patience as our various sub-teams prepare GitHub repositories with the basic verification infrastructure, documentation tooling and shovel-ready issues needed for contributors!

Here is a simple guide on How to Contribute:
https://github.com/Beneficial-AI-Foundation/signal-shot#how-to-contribute

We also have a Review Process for pull requests. The basic idea is to pick an Issue on GitHub, fork our repo and submit a Pull Request. The request will be reviewed by the BAIF team and by our Collaborators. Because the reviews will ultimately be done by humans, please be kind to document your proposed changes and to break up potentially large PRs into small coherent chunks.
https://github.com/Beneficial-AI-Foundation/signal-shot#review-process

Over the next few weeks, you will start to see additional information about our GitHub repos in new topics on this channel. In those topics, you can ask questions about the issues, discuss strategies for solving them and look for people to work with.
